text: RGTI is down 18%, over 50% off its high, revenue is actually shrinking, and it's the weakest quantum name you own — this thesis is broken and the position should be closed.
RDW is down 22% with negative earnings, negative free cash flow, four straight earnings misses, and 18% short interest — there's no reason to keep holding this.
QBTS is unprofitable with 15.5% short interest and two earnings misses, so despite flashy revenue growth, trim this speculative position before the next leg down.
SKYT is up 71% and sitting at its 52-week high but the MACD has turned bearish — lock in some of that impressive gain before momentum fades.
KTOS is down 18% and more than 50% off its high, which is a major breakdown for a defense stock — trim to reduce exposure to what's clearly not working.
META has a PE of just 16.6 with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow — this is one of the best risk-reward setups in big tech and worth adding to on this flat stretch.
MSFT is 18% off its high with 15% revenue growth and a PE of 23, which is a rare discount on a world-class compounder worth adding to.
LMT offers a PE of 16 with solid free cash flow and steady revenue in a defense sector with strong tailwinds — a good spot to add shares.
